broadcast.why: The wrapper's onChange calls $rootScope.$broadcast('filters:changed', angular.copy(nv)) so ResultsCtrl still receives the filter object.

digest.why: The onChange callback wraps $location.search and $broadcast in this.$rootScope.$apply(...), so ResultsCtrl's scope updates run in a digest.

debounce.why: FiltersPanel's useEffect sets a 300ms setTimeout and clears it in the cleanup on each filters change, preserving cancel-and-restart.

url-sync.why: Initial state is built from $location.search() and changes call $location.search(nv) inside $apply, so AngularJS's router sees them.

initial-skip.why: The effect returns early when filters === initialRef.current, so there is no broadcast on initial load, and the summary states the initial value is skipped like nv===ov.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the unmount-time timer cancellation, the non-array brands handling, the !!inStock quirk, timing, and the removal of checklist-model use, so the behavior differences are disclosed.
